sn11.4:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme …pe… bhagavā etadavoca
sn11.4:1.3: atha kho bhikkhave vepacitti asurindo asure āmantesi
sn11.4:1.4: sace mārisā devāsurasaṅgāme samupabyūḷhe asurā jineyyuṃ devā parājineyyuṃ yena naṃ sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha asurapuranti.
sn11.4:1.5: sakkopi kho bhikkhave devānamindo deve tāvatiṃse āmantesi
sn11.4:1.6: sace mārisā devāsurasaṅgāme samupabyūḷhe devā jineyyuṃ asurā parājineyyuṃ yena naṃ vepacittiṃ asurindaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha sudhammaṃ sabhanti.
sn11.4:1.7: tasmiṃ kho pana bhikkhave saṅgāme devā jiniṃsu asurā parājiniṃsu.
sn11.4:1.8: atha kho bhikkhave devā tāvatiṃsā vepacittiṃ asurindaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā sakkassa devānamindassa santike ānesuṃ sudhammaṃ sabhaṃ.
sn11.4:1.9: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave vepacitti asurindo kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandho sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ sudhammaṃ sabhaṃ pavisantañca nikkhamantañca asabbhāhi pharusāhi vācāhi akkosati paribhāsati.
sn11.4:1.10: atha kho bhikkhave mātali saṅgāhako sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
sn11.4:13.1: so hi nāma bhikkhave sakko devānamindo sakaṃ puññaphalaṃ upajīvamāno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ issariyādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kārento khantisoraccassa vaṇṇavādī bhavissati.
sn11.4:13.2: idha khvetaṃ bhikkhave sobhetha yaṃ tumhe evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā khamā ca bhaveyyātha soratā cāti.
